name: csnl-researcher-archiver
description: CSNL lab researcher self-archive plugin. Per-researcher terminal CLI that builds a Phase 1 hierarchical memory DB through map-first grounded interview. Supports up to 20 researchers via config/researchers.yaml. Supabase-backed central archive with optimistic-CAS conflict resolution.
loader_notes: CLAUDE.md at plugin root is read by install.sh and copied into ~/.claude/projects/csnl-researcher-archiver/memory/CLAUDE.md so it is always-loaded for sessions launched from that project scope. Plugin-root CLAUDE.md is not automatically loaded by every Claude Code session.
